ctx.x: I think he was with him years ago. Amos Gayle (PHONETIC). He's a guy to be remembered. No one knows -- he was a street cleaner when he died. And just like -- just like King Oliver was selling clams or something on the street. You know. That's a damn shame. It's a shame. This guy should be remembered because they are great musicians. And you know KIng Oliver was a great musician. He was one of the great firsts.
